move.subject: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Another bidder's offer for this part stands at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Hallo,
got your mail, thanks.
ok, we can do that.
Our terms: a price of €32.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.
Here is how it is:
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.
We did not know that - a fair point.
I don't have a fancy cost breakdown for you, just a fair price for good work.
Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Back to the machines now.
Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. I don't have a fancy cost breakdown for you, just a fair price for good work. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
